media_work.title: The Farm: Angola, USA
media_work.focus_or_theme: Life and death inside Louisiana State Penitentiary (Angola), perspectives of inmates serving long sentences (including life).
media_work.summaryNotes: Awarded Grand Jury Prize at Sundance Film Festival.

media_item.focus_or_theme: Life and death inside Louisiana State Penitentiary (Angola), perspectives of inmates serving long sentences (including life).
media_item.summary_notes: This highly regarded documentary offers a powerful look inside Angola. While the theme of potential innocence exists (particularly with Vincent Simmons), the film is more broadly about the human experience within the prison, covering parole hearings, the prison hospice, the execution process, and daily life.

research_notes_other.notes_from_film_list.txt: Follows stories of several inmates at Angola Prison, including some who maintain their innocence. Available via YouTube, Amazon, DVD.
